about: Texture manifest (v2). Source images live in client/public/assets/<file>; run `npm run textures` to validate them and write processed KTX2 + WebP sets to client/public/assets/textures/_processed/ (the 'processed' field of each entry is written by the script). Missing or rejected files fall back to the built-in procedural textures, so an entry can exist before its image does. type: tile (repeats both ways) | tile-x (repeats left-right only) | tile-y (top-bottom only) | atlas (grid of cells) | sprite | overlay | decal. sizeM: metres covered by one copy [width, height]. maxSize: longest side per quality preset (sources are ~1254 px, so 1024 is the largest power of two without upscaling). group: colour-normalisation group. normal: normal-map strength (0 = none). roughness: [min, max] range of the generated roughness map. rotate: random UV rotation per terrain tile is allowed (false for rows, roads, walls, strata). materials: game materials that use it.
